_comment: Fleet definition for `edge deploy`. Don't hand-edit this example — run `edge fleet` to generate fleet.json (gitignored) interactively, or copy this file to fleet.json and fill it in. Single source of truth for the deploy + the HAProxy backend list.
_order_note: Node ORDER is the routing priority: HAProxy `balance first` sends each request to the first-listed healthy node and overflows to later ones only when it's saturated or down. List your strongest/preferred node first.
_ssh_note: ssh values: 'user@host' (SSH+rsync), 'interop' (a Windows node managed via WSL->Windows interop when you deploy from that box), or '' (skip; set up manually).
_models_note: 'model' is the cluster default (use the NON-thinking qwen instruct build — hybrid-thinking models burn tokens per tool step and leak the monologue). A node may add an optional 'models' list; nodes without one serve the default. `edge model set <name> [--node X]` pulls + records these, and HAProxy routes each request to a node that actually has the requested model.
_embed_note: An embedding model (e.g. nomic-embed-text) can ride on a text node's 'models' list, for any app doing semantic search / vector recall. Pull it onto a node without changing the default: `edge model set nomic-embed-text --node <name>`. (storefront-ai no longer needs one — it moved to SQLite with no vector recall.)
_keep_alive_note: A node may set optional 'keep_alive': how long its Ollama keeps a model loaded in memory after a request (duration string like "24h", or -1 = never unload). Omit for Ollama's default (5m: the first request after idle cold-loads the model). The chat app applies it whenever that node serves a request, pinned or load-balanced.
_role_note: A node may set 'role': 'image' — it hosts image models (ComfyUI/SD API on optional 'image_port', default 8188) instead of the text-LLM rotation: excluded from HAProxy/CLUSTER_NODES/Ollama ops, and apps get IMAGE_BASE_URL pointing at it. Typical split: GPU box = image, small/efficient nodes = document flow.
_image_model_note: An image node declares its model the same way any node does — a 'models' list. The FIRST entry is what apps receive as IMAGE_MODEL; the rest are just also installed there. `edge model set <name> --node <image node>` promotes one to the front (it only records — ComfyUI weights are installed on that box, not pulled by Ollama).
_usecase_note: Roles map onto storefront-ai's needs: it pins qwen2.5:7b-instruct as its workhorse (category + subreddit research, drills, product/listing text) and can optionally offload the knowledge-heavy category brainstorm to a bigger model (qwen2.5:14b) on a strong node — so declare 7b (+ optional 14b) on your beefiest text node (a 12GB+ Mac), keep small Jetsons on the 4b default for overflow, and route it all through the HAProxy master. The GPU box (role image) = FLUX product mockups + POD print files, hit directly on image_port (Feature 2+).
